leads.organization_name: Shenzhen Feetech RC Model Co., Ltd.

evidence.claim: The official AlohaMini2 BOM specifies Feetech STS-3215 and STS-3095 servos across the base and both arm systems.
Feetech's official site publishes a business connection channel and describes customization and OEM services.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can publish verified model identifiers, regional sourcing links, and compatibility evidence while Feetech can supply canonical product data, lifecycle notices, and an approved distributor list.
leads.first_contact_goal: Request permission to maintain a verified Feetech manufacturer profile and obtain canonical specifications and distributor links for the servo models used by AlohaMini2 and SO-101.
leads.notes: Do not request pricing commitments in the first contact. Start with data accuracy and provenance.

evidence.claim: The official AlohaMini2 BOM specifies the Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter A for the mobile base, follower arms, and leader arms.
Waveshare's official page publishes electrical, interface, compatibility, support, distributor, and customization information for the adapter.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can connect verified project BOM demand to the official product and documentation pages while Waveshare can provide stable SKUs, regional distributors, revision notices, and volume purchasing guidance.
leads.first_contact_goal: Ask for a verified catalog relationship for Bus Servo Adapter A and the correct regional distributor and lifecycle metadata.

evidence.claim: The official repository publishes AlohaMini2 and AlohaMini2 Pro store listings and a public project contact email.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can maintain the source-pinned BOM, assembly guide, authentic imagery, and regional sourcing references while the project team can validate revisions and direct builders to official kits or support.
leads.first_contact_goal: Request review of the public AlohaMini2 catalog entry and permission to identify the official store and future revision notices.

evidence.claim: The canonical SO-ARM100 repository lists Robonine as an international kit vendor that includes parts kits.
Robonine publicly offers SO-ARM101 kits and a pre-purchase booking channel.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can surface kit completeness, region, lead-time evidence, and project compatibility while Robonine can provide current kit contents, fulfillment regions, and revision-specific substitutions.
leads.first_contact_goal: Request a machine-readable current kit manifest and permission to list Robonine as a verified SO-ARM101 kit source.

evidence.claim: The canonical SO-ARM100 repository lists Seeed Studio as an international and regional kit source.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can map official kits to exact project revisions and regional storefronts while Seeed can provide stable kit SKUs, contents, inventory regions, and substitution policies.
leads.first_contact_goal: Request an authoritative kit contents feed and revision compatibility statement for SO-100 and SO-101 variants.

evidence.claim: The canonical SO-ARM100 repository lists ForgeMotion Labs as a US source for printed frames, electronics, and complete arm kits.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can distinguish frame, electronics, and complete-kit offers against the canonical BOM while ForgeMotion can provide exact kit manifests and US fulfillment evidence.
leads.first_contact_goal: Request current contents and lead-time metadata for each kit tier and permission to label the listings as verified.

evidence.claim: The canonical SO-ARM100 repository lists PartaBot as a US source for assembled systems and related LeKiwi and Koch robots.

leads.proposed_value_exchange: RoboPartPicker can connect builders who need assembled systems to revision-specific offers while PartaBot can provide build configuration, regional fulfillment, support scope, and lead-time data.
leads.first_contact_goal: Request a verified assembled-system configuration and clarify which canonical BOM revision each offer implements.
